theme.primary_mode: Light base with Dark Graphite signature Hero and Sections

color_rules.safety_orange_usage: Reserved strictly for primary call-to-action buttons, active navigation indicators, small eyebrow tags, and high-priority status badges. NEVER use as a large background blanket.
color_rules.gradient_policy: NO bright gradients, neon effects, or glossy web2.0 gradients. Use solid tactile tones, matte surfaces, and subtle 1px mechanical borders.
color_rules.contrast_policy: Ensure all text meets APCA high-legibility standards. Dark Graphite (#252925) text on Concrete White (#F5F3EE) or Pure White (#FFFFFF), and Pure White text on Dark Graphite (#252925) surfaces.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.eyebrow_label: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#D96C36]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: py-16 lg:py-24 for major sections; max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 for main containers.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Asymmetric multi-span layout for product showcase (e.g., col-span-12 md:col-span-8 for primary spotlight card, col-span-12 md:col-span-4 for technical spec callout).
layout_and_spacing.card_padding: p-6 sm:p-8 internal padding on all bordered cards to prevent text-to-edge collision.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #E3E3DC in light sections, 1px solid #323732 in dark sections. Clean square or 4px subtle rounded corners (rounded-sm or rounded-md).

header_and_nav.style: Sticky top bar. Starts semi-transparent with dark graphite tint on hero, transitions into dense solid glass backdrop-blur-md bg-[#252925]/90 text-white border-b border-[#323732]/60 on scroll.
header_and_nav.brand_mark: Original geometric SVG logo: Heavy square manhole frame with inner concentric circle cover motif and SCW initials in crisp mono.

header_cta.label: Request a Quote
header_cta.style: bg-[#D96C36] hover:bg-[#c25e2c] text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-sm font-semibold text-sm transition-colors

media_and_images.image_treatment_rules: All photos must be set inside warm concrete-white panels (#F5F3EE) with subtle 1px border (#E3E3DC) or graphite overlays (#252925/40). Never warp or distort product aspect ratios. Use object-cover with explicit height constraints.

animations.card_hover: Subtle border highlight shift from #E3E3DC to #D96C36 and slight lift -translate-y-1 transition duration 200ms
animations.fade_up_section: Opacity 0 to 1, Y 20px to 0px viewport scroll trigger once

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: Mandatory on all clickable items, search inputs, modal triggers, product filter tabs, and form submission buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent.core_directive: Build an award-winning, engineered B2B industrial website for Sindhu Cement Works using React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Ensure dark graphite (#252925) and warm concrete white (#F5F3EE) set an authentic architectural tone, while Safety Orange (#D96C36) provides tactical contrast for primary actions.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Ensure complete multi-page navigation and rich modals: Home, /products, 5 Product Detail Views, Quotation Builder Modal, About, and Contact pages.
instructions_to_main_agent.no_mock_failure: Implement functional React state management for live product filtering, search, quotation builder multi-step form, and lightbox.
